verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product like sevDesk, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, cookie consent, or tracking opt-out controls. The material covers invoicing, bookkeeping, API, versioning and changelog features only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
